run_convert_bilingual_srt_batch: run the script to batch convert all bilingual SRT files in a folder to monolingual
convert_bilingual_to_monolingual_srt: convert a bilingual SRT subtitle file to monolingual by keeping only the first language line
review_convert_function: review the convert function that parses SRT files and filters bilingual captions to monolingual
refactor_convert_for_new_formats: refactor the convert function to support additional caption file formats beyond SRT
summarize_convert_function: summarize the convert function that processes SRT subtitle blocks and extracts single language lines
